name: admission_offer
description: Sent to the parent when a place is offered (including after an upheld appeal).
subject: Offer of a place for {child_first_name} ({application_ref})
body: We are pleased to offer {child_first_name} a place in Year {year_group} for {academic_year}.
Please let us know whether you accept this place by {offer_expires}. If we have not heard from you by then, the offer will lapse and the place may be offered to another child.
If you accept, {child_first_name} can start from {start_date}.

placeholders.child_first_name: The child's preferred or first name
placeholders.child_name: The child's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.academic_year: The academic year applied for, e.g. 2026/27
placeholders.offer_expires: The date the parent must reply by
